name: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology

hero.title: MIIT,
hero.lede: China’s industry ministry: compute plans, AI standards, telecom rules and quiet guidance to buyers. It never answers Washington in public; it steers Chinese firms instead.

short_answer.title: It co-signs CAC’s rules
short_answer.body: MIIT co-issued CAC’s deep-synthesis, generative-AI and anthropomorphic-AI measures within days of CAC signing them, the clearest sign of the commission’s office leading and ministries following.

short_answer.title: When Washington eases, MIIT gates
short_answer.body: After the US let NVIDIA sell again, MIIT asked Chinese buyers to justify foreign chips, or approved purchases only on conditions. Two episodes: still a signal.

purpose.summary: MIIT’s plans, standards and buyer guidance are in its control, so its record can forecast how Beijing steers firms after US chip moves and new AI waves.
use_for: After Washington eases chip sales, will Chinese buyers be steered back to domestic chips?
Which CAC-led AI rules will MIIT co-issue, and how soon?
After a new AI product class takes off, what promotion plan or standards body follows?
dont_use_for: Public responses to US rules: MIIT makes none; MOFCOM and the foreign ministry speak.
Outright purchase bans, which came from CAC and customs.

standing.class_role: State · ministry under the State Council for industry, telecom, software and chips.
standing.principal: The State Council. It co-issues and implements Cyberspace Commission rules.
standing.attribution_rule: A row is MIIT’s when MIIT issues or co-issues it, or when reporting names MIIT as the body giving guidance. Unattributed directives (the 2025 data-centre chip order, C401) are context.
standing.veto_players: CAC, which leads the AI conduct rules MIIT co-signs; NDRC and MOFCOM on chip purchases (MI13).
standing.gates_held: Telecom licensing, state carriers’ equipment (MI06), and guidance on chip purchases by large firms (MI10).

powers.use: Co-issues CAC’s AI rules; issues its own data rules
powers.limit: Never the lead drafter of content rules

powers.use: Guidance and approvals on foreign-chip purchases
powers.limit: Unpublished window guidance, known only through reporting
Holds telecom enforcement powers, not exercised in this log

powers.use: Plans and campaigns: compute, AI+ manufacturing, humanoid training
Orders to replace US chips in state networks
Compute vouchers for AI service providers

rules.name: Washington eases → buyers steered
rules.when: Washington lets NVIDIA sell more to China
rules.then: MIIT asks Chinese buyers to justify NVIDIA orders, or approves purchases only on conditions, within weeks
rules.note: Unpublished guidance reported by the FT and Reuters. The outright blocks were CAC (C08) and customs, not MIIT.

rules.name: Washington tightens → quiet substitution
rules.then: No public statement; months later, a quiet order to replace US chips in state networks
rules.note: One episode, and three US moves with no logged MIIT act. Public answers come from MOFCOM and the foreign ministry.

rules.name: CAC signs an AI rule → MIIT co-issues
rules.when: CAC signs an AI rule that MIIT co-issues
rules.then: MIIT co-issues and publishes it within days
rules.note: Dates are MIIT’s publication dates against CAC’s signing dates. The 2026 anthropomorphic-AI measures fall after the cutoff, so only two build episodes count; the data proposes a signal until a third arrives.

rules.name: Chinese open model breaks out → MIIT promotes adoption
rules.when: A Chinese lab releases a major open model
rules.then: MIIT promotes its adoption by state firms within weeks
rules.note: One episode: state carriers integrated DeepSeek within weeks of R1’s market shock (C03).

limits.title: Window guidance is invisible
limits.body: MIIT’s chip guidance is unpublished; rows rest on FT, Reuters and Bloomberg reporting.

limits.title: Silent on US rules
limits.body: Searches found no MIIT statement after the 2022, 2023 or 2024 US controls; this is a finding, not a gap in collection.

limits.title: One coder
limits.body: Triggers were coded once (P6 not done).
